items.title: Bruce Johnstone interviewed by Monk Rowe, Dunkirk, New York, October 11, 2013
items.q: Ben Webster was also another one who, because he wouldn’t fly, the Copenhagen Radio Orchestra would send me out with him so we’d ride trains and buses and boats and things to get to the gigs.

ctx.x: And it was magical because he would engage the audience to understand the story he was telling, and then play it. And you could feel it the whole way. And the sound, just the clarity of sound. Everything was solid from the bottom of the horn to the top of the horn. There were no — nothing sounded strained, and which was something I’d always heard with baritone players, the top end was always, you know, you’re dragging it up with your lip. And so I watched him a lot as he was doing it, and he was really, really…
